name: Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells stainless steel wires in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It offers stainless-steel wires, such as spring, micro, cold heading, shaft, weaving, and high alloy/titanium wires for use in vehicles, aircraft, office automation appliances, electric appliances, medical instruments, commodities, and leisure goods, as well as screws, steel nettings, etc. The company also offers filament yarn, cloth, tape, belt, felt, knit, sleeve, chop, and other metal fibers under the NASLON brand name.
